LCMC Health Patient Portal

The free online Patient Portal gives patients convenient access to their medical information and care-management tools.

Use the portal to review available health records, communicate through supported features, and manage eligible billing tasks from one secure account.

Schedule an appointment for a child well visit, sick visit, or vaccine, then finish through My LCMC Health or as a guest.

Access the Patient Portal
fields.pageSummary: Use the secure LCMC Health Patient Portal to access medical information and manage eligible care tasks.
fields.metadataDescription: Stay connected to your care through the LCMC Health Patient Portal.
